name: Topic: Mexican politician stubs ('affiliated', 'LX', 'served')
description: In Wikipedia stubs about Mexican politicians it supplies the stock continuations of the field: "politician affiliated" (to a party), "Deputy of the LX" (Legislature), "From 2006 to 2009 he served", "Secretary and council". Ablated, the model prefers a period, "and", "Congress" or "was" ("he was" with p ≈ 0.93 instead of "he served").
